title: KillManiac's modpack
description: with pvp and optimization perfect for low end and old pcs
body:
download and find out peak of performance and pvp
In this modpack i have included all the mods you will need for mojo/pojav or for a low end laptop or pc it has alll the required mods and libs for the mods in it and has been tested by 5 people who have laptops older than 6 years and not gaming laptops normal daily office work type devices and the results were 500-600 fps in each device so if you want Pvp and OPtimization in one i suggest this modpack 
NOTE: it has some mods which require configuration to work such as Totem Tweaks for it to work you have to open the mod menu and search totem tweaks hover over its icon and open the options and set it to your preferences if you need any help configuring the modpack you can Join my discord server from links included with the project thank you for downloading
